raw_results.cause: Fungal pathogen Cercospora beticola, spread by wind and rain splash

eco_remedies.method: Mix 1 tablespoon of baking soda and 1 teaspoon of vegetable oil in 1 gallon of water. Spray thoroughly on leaves.
Dilute neem oil according to manufacturer instructions and spray on affected foliage.

prevention: Practice crop rotation with non-host crops for at least 2 years.
Ensure proper spacing between plants to improve air circulation and reduce humidity.

raw_results.cause: Phytophthora infestans; spread via airborne spores (zoospores) and water splashing

eco_remedies.method: Mix 1 tablespoon baking soda, 1 teaspoon vegetable oil, and 0.5 teaspoon mild liquid soap in 1 gallon of water. Spray thoroughly covering upper and lower leaf surfaces.
Apply organic copper-based fungicide (like copper hydroxide) to foliage. Ensure good coverage, especially the undersides of leaves.

prevention: Ensure good air circulation by proper spacing between plants.
Water the base of the plants to avoid wetting the foliage.
Remove and destroy infected leaves immediately to stop the spread.
